title: Billing and Coding: Frequency of Laboratory Tests

codes.1: Note : Providers are reminded to refer to the long descriptors of the CPT codes in their CPT book.

covered.1: It is the provider’s responsibility to select codes carried out to the highest level of specificity and selected from the ICD-10-CM code book appropriate to the year in which the service is rendered for the claim(s) submitted. Medicare is establishing the following limited coverage for CPT/HCPCS codes 80061, 82465, 82948 , 82962, 82985, 83036, 83718, 83721, 84436, 84439, 84443, 84478 and 84479 : Refer to the NCDs for the procedure code list of ICD-10-CM codes that are covered by Medicare at: https://www.cms.gov/Medicare/Coverage/CoverageGenInfo/LabNCDsICD10.html

noncovered.1: All those not listed under the “ICD-10 Codes that Support Medical Necessity” section of this article. Refer to the NCDs for the procedure code list of ICD-10-CM codes that are considered non-covered or do not support medical necessity at: https://www.cms.gov/Medicare/Coverage/CoverageGenInfo/LabNCDsICD10.html
